title: S3 CDE and Information Container State Systems

entries.name: Work in Progress
entries.meaning: Active authoring and internal quality activity within the originating task-team context. Information remains in Work in Progress until the applicable review and approval-for-sharing activity is completed.

entries.name: Shared
entries.meaning: Information made available for the permitted shared purpose after the applicable review and approval-for-sharing activity. TIVERIT maps the Work in Progress to Shared transition to ISO 19650-4 Decision A. Shared information is not yet Published and remains subject to the applicable information-model review, authorization, submission and acceptance process before transition to Published where ISO 19650-2 delivery provisions apply.

entries.name: Published
entries.meaning: Information transitioned from Shared after completion of the applicable authorization and acceptance process. TIVERIT maps the Shared to Published transition to ISO 19650-4 Decision B; where ISO 19650-2 delivery provisions apply, lead appointed party authorization precedes appointing party acceptance. Published records the resulting information state and shall remain traceable to the underlying decision evidence, status and permitted use.

entries.name: Archived
entries.meaning: Controlled historical record of information-container transactions, revisions, statuses and decision evidence. Archiving preserves the record and is not a substitute for approval, authorization, acceptance or handover decisions.

entries.name: Work in Progress
entries.permitted_use: Internal task-team production and checking within the declared scope; transition to Shared requires the applicable approval-for-sharing activity.

entries.name: Shared / For Review
entries.permitted_use: Shared-state coordination/review for the declared purpose after approval for sharing; this context does not replace the subsequent authorization and acceptance process required for transition to Published.

entries.name: Formal Submission / Issued for Declared Use
entries.permitted_use: Formal issue context governed by the applicable ISO 19650-2 information-model delivery sequence and project information requirements. Permitted use and status shall remain explicit and traceable.

entries.name: Record / As-Built Submission
entries.permitted_use: Project-defined record or handover submission context. The label does not itself establish a supplementary TIVERIT handover-acceptance decision or operational reliance unless the applicable project governance requires and records it.

decision_a.meaning: Review and approval for sharing before information is made available in Shared.
decision_a.iso_mapping: ISO 19650-4 Decision A; supported by ISO 19650-2 collaborative production and approval-for-sharing activity.

decision_b.meaning: Applicable authorization and acceptance process before information is made available in Published.
decision_b.iso_mapping: ISO 19650-4 Decision B; where ISO 19650-2 delivery provisions apply, lead appointed party authorization is followed by appointing party acceptance.

archive.meaning: Historical record preservation of information-container transactions and evidence; not an additional approval or acceptance decision.

state_semantics.information_state: Describes the managed lifecycle position of an information container in the CDE and, for Shared and Published, records the outcome of the applicable ISO 19650 transition process.
state_semantics.deliverable_issue_state: Describes the declared issue context, status or intended use of a deliverable package and shall be interpreted with the applicable information requirements and exchange process.
state_semantics.decision_relationship: For ISO 19650-governed exchanges, information state and transition decision are coupled: Decision A controls Work in Progress to Shared and Decision B controls Shared to Published. The resulting state is not a substitute for the underlying audit evidence.
state_semantics.authority_rule: Platform permission, folder location, workflow ownership or technical transition capability does not independently assign the ISO 19650 party responsibility for approval, authorization or acceptance.

transition_evidence.rule: Decision-bearing transitions shall remain traceable to the applicable review activity, decision outcome, responsible ISO 19650 party or project-mapped function, affected information scope, status/permitted use, evidence reference, and transition actor where applicable.
transition_evidence.execution_boundary: The person or system executing the technical CDE transition may differ from the party responsible for the underlying review or decision; technical execution capability shall not be treated as assignment of that responsibility.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-005 re-audit aligns the implementation registry to the ISO 19650 exchange backbone: Work in Progress to Shared follows approval for sharing (Decision A mapping); Shared to Published follows the applicable authorization and acceptance process (Decision B mapping); Archived preserves the historical record. ACC issue lifecycle remains separately governed under S5.
